valid_scores.name: valid_scores
valid_scores.value: ("matches"."home_score" IS NULL AND "matches"."away_score" IS NULL) OR ("matches"."home_score" >= 0 AND "matches"."away_score" >= 0 AND "matches"."home_score" IS NOT NULL AND "matches"."away_score" IS NOT NULL)

finished_has_scores.name: finished_has_scores
finished_has_scores.value: "matches"."status" <> 'finished' OR ("matches"."home_score" IS NOT NULL AND "matches"."away_score" IS NOT NULL)
